identity.label: Mouse preimplantation development, zygote to morula
identity.what_it_is: a reference trajectory assembled from published stage structure, to exercise the format against a real developmental series rather than an invented one

reference.note: wild type. This trajectory carries no edits - it is the baseline a design would be compared against.

stages.name: zygote
stages.note: UTMM does NOT cover this stage. Both of its abstracts say "from the zygote", but every reported cohort starts at late 2-cell (transcriptome) or 4-cell (mechanics), and no zygote transcriptome, mechanics value or cell count appears in the accessible text. This row carries standard embryology only.

provenance.scope: the drawn arrangement of blastomeres at this stage; not any specimen
provenance.note: spheres of conserved total volume in a fixed shell. A drawing, not a measurement: real blastomeres are flattened against their neighbours and compaction changes shape without changing volume.

geometry.note: exposed surface area not established; it is the geometric quantity UTMM finds lineage bias tracks, and it cannot be derived from a sphere packing

cell_count.source: standard mouse preimplantation timing; cleavage stages by embryonic day, E0.5 = plug morning
cell_count.scope: mouse preimplantation embryo at this stage
cell_count.note: the cleavage series is not in dispute

total_volume_conserved.note: the zona pellucida holds volume roughly constant through cleavage. Assumed here so the drawing is consistent; not measured on any embryo.

cytoplasmic_compliance.why: UTMM's per-cell mechanics channel is a RELATIVE compliance reported as RMSD0 and dRMSD, with no values in nm in the accessible text and no published conversion to stress. There is no per-cell number to carry, and inventing a modulus would make the file lie in a way no reader could detect.
cytoplasmic_compliance.searched: Habibi E, Sinha A, Yang H, et al. Unified Transcriptome and Mechanics Map of the Intact Mammalian Preimplantation Embryo In Situ. bioRxiv 2026. doi:10.64898/2026.02.23.706394 (PMID 42124641) (bioRxiv v2, 2026-10-23; the PMC deposit is the older v1 and still says "elastic modulus")
cytoplasmic_compliance.what_would_resolve_it: the supplementary PDF, which holds the Methods and presumably the RMSD values; or the data. It is in-house work, so asking is cheap
cytoplasmic_compliance.scope: cytoplasm of a blastomere at this stage

not_established.what: which stages were observed and which were filled in
not_established.answer: NONE were observed by us. Every stage is assembled from published structure, and observed:false is set on all of them.

not_established.what: for each channel, on how many cells it was actually measured
not_established.answer: zero. geometry is depicted on every cell; mechanics and transcriptome are absent per cell and present only as a per-stage ordinal.

not_established.what: whether the geometry is a measurement, a reconstruction, or a drawing
not_established.answer: a drawing. Spheres of conserved total volume in a fixed shell.

not_established.what: what the file cannot be used to simulate
not_established.answer: anything mechanical. There is no modulus, no adhesion, no cortical tension and no zona. It can be rendered and it can be compared stage-for-stage on cell count; it cannot be used to predict a fate decision.

not_established.what: exposed surface area, the quantity lineage bias tracks
not_established.answer: not established, and not derivable from this packing.
absent. UTMM measures it per cell in situ (150-gene targeted panel, 742 cells across 69 embryos); we have the paper, not the data.

not_established.what: anything at all about the zygote, from UTMM
not_established.answer: UTMM does not cover it. Both abstracts say "from the zygote" and every reported cohort starts at late 2-cell (3DISS) or 4-cell (mechanics). The zygote row here is standard embryology only.

does not exist. UTMM's per-cell channel is a RELATIVE compliance (RMSD0, dRMSD) with no nm values published and no conversion to stress. The pascal figures in the paper are from a separate optical-tweezers validation on endocytosed beads and are carried under their own name.

not_established.what: why Hippo/YAP is not mentioned anywhere in this file
not_established.answer: because it is not UTMM's result. The line about positional geometry rather than cell shape predicting Hippo/YAP cites prior work (Royer et al. 2020, Development, doi:10.1242/dev.189449). UTMM never measures YAP; its own claim is that geometry separates transcriptionally defined states.

not carried. Only the 2-cell figure (42-44 h) is measured in the literature; the rest would be arithmetic on a 10 h doubling time, and UTMM's own embryos were cultured from 4-cell in KSOM, which runs slower than in vivo.
